text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Wah...! Is this a birthday present!?\nI 
wonder what it is, I wonder what it is~."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Its name is— "Steal Everyone's Gaze☆ 
'Hat Lover' Makeover Project"!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
To further enhance your individuality. 
Consider that our gift to you.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oooh~! You remembered how I was worrying 
about wanting my own distinct personality!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Your love for hats, polished well, it 
ought to radiate a dazzling brilliance... 
Let us play an ensemble together, amore.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Nice to work with you! Um, so I just 
say this line to the hat, right?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Yahoo~. How are you doing, Eimun-kun? How 
are you feeling today~?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"'...Oh, so it's the best! Ehehe, I'm so 
glad.'"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Chatting with your favorite hat—now that's 
individuality! ...Still, we could get a 
bit more creative with the pose.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
A pose... How about something like this, 
then!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Bravissimo! That beautiful posture of 
yours... Even your hat sings with joy.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
......Yeah! I think this feels pretty 
good!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
If it has this much of a "BOOM!" feeling 
to it, maybe people will think it's 
unique...! Alright, let's keep pushing 
forward like this~!
